title: テーブルサッカー台
description: 交流室・宿泊施設の遊戯コーナー向けのテーブルサッカー台。凹んだ競技面と立体ライン、八本のロッド、固定した22人の選手、両端の実開口ゴールと受け皿、スコア用ビーズ、傾斜脚と調整足の外観を造形。選手・ボール・操作棒は台に含む一式で1点です。回転・スライド・得点処理・物理動作は未実装で、競技規格・実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.192 × 0.907 × 1.633 m、38,324三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A table-football prop for community rooms and hospitality recreation corners. It includes a recessed field with modeled lines, eight rods, 22 fixed player figures, genuinely open end goals and catch trays, score beads, splayed legs and leveling-foot exteriors. Figures, ball and rods form one table assembly. Rotation, sliding, scoring and ball physics are not implemented; competitive specifications and real equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.192 × 0.907 × 1.633 m; 38,324 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
